description.en: Generates daily river water-chemistry time series by preserving observed values and estimating missing values using linear interpolation, Generalized Additive Models (GAM), monthly discharge regressions, and monthly-median interpolation. Candidate methods are evaluated using blocked holdout validation and screened for sufficient validation points, coverage, R² and relative bias. Methods with similar R² are compared using normalized prediction error, relative bias and R². Remaining gaps may be filled using gap-limited linear interpolation or model-based fallback methods, with an observed-range plausibility check used to rank the latter.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: List of variable names to process.

variable_units.title: Variable units
variable_units.description: List of variable=unit pairs giving the unit of each variable.

non_mass_vars.title: Non-mass variables
non_mass_vars.description: List of variable names that are not mass concentrations (e.g. pH, temperature) and therefore must not be converted to loads or fluxes.

url_waterchem.title: Water chemistry input
url_waterchem.description: URL of the input water chemistry file.

url_discharge.title: Discharge input
url_discharge.description: URL of the input river discharge file.

river_name.title: River name
river_name.description: Name of the river for which the interpolation is performed.

waterchem_station_name.title: Water chemistry station name
waterchem_station_name.description: Name of the water chemistry monitoring station to select from the water chemistry file.

discharge_station_name.title: Discharge station name
discharge_station_name.description: Name of the discharge gauging station to select from the discharge file.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

waterchem_time_col.title: Water chemistry time column
waterchem_time_col.description: Name of the time coordinate or column in the input water-chemistry dataset. Default: sample_date.

discharge_time_col.title: Discharge time column
discharge_time_col.description: Name of the time coordinate or column in the input river-discharge dataset. Default: time.

waterchem_station_col.title: Water chemistry station column
waterchem_station_col.description: Name of the station coordinate or column in the input water-chemistry dataset. Default: station_name.

discharge_station_col.title: Discharge station column
discharge_station_col.description: Name of the station coordinate or column in the input river-discharge dataset. Default: station_name.

discharge_var.title: Discharge variable
discharge_var.description: Name of the river-discharge variable in the input NetCDF dataset. Default: discharge.

linear_max_gap.title: Maximum gap for linear interpolation
linear_max_gap.description: Maximum number of consecutive missing daily values that may be filled by linear interpolation. Longer gaps are not filled by this method. Must be a non-negative integer. Default: 90.

gam_n_splines_q.title: GAM splines for discharge
gam_n_splines_q.description: Number of spline basis functions used for the discharge term of the Generalized Additive Model (GAM). Must be a positive integer. Default: 10.

gam_n_splines_doy.title: GAM splines for day of year
gam_n_splines_doy.description: Number of spline basis functions used for the seasonal (day-of-year) term of the Generalized Additive Model (GAM). Must be a positive integer. Default: 20.

validation_repeats.title: Validation repeats
validation_repeats.description: Number of blocked holdout validation repetitions used to evaluate candidate interpolation methods. Must be a positive integer. Default: 10.

validation_block_size.title: Validation block size
validation_block_size.description: Number of consecutive observed data points withheld together in each blocked holdout validation block. Must be a positive integer. Default: 2.

validation_min_observations.title: Minimum observations for validation
validation_min_observations.description: Minimum number of observed water-chemistry values required to perform blocked holdout validation for an interpolation method. Must be a positive integer. Default: 20.

validation_min_points.title: Minimum validation points
validation_min_points.description: Minimum number of valid observed-predicted pairs required for an interpolation method to be eligible for selection. Must be a positive integer. Default: 10.

validation_min_coverage.title: Minimum validation coverage
validation_min_coverage.description: Minimum fraction of withheld validation observations for which a candidate interpolation method must produce valid predictions to be eligible for selection. Must be between 0 and 1. Default: 0.50.

selection_min_r2.title: Minimum R² for model selection
selection_min_r2.description: Minimum validation R² required for a candidate interpolation method to be eligible for selection. Must be between -1 and 1. Default: 0.45.

selection_r2_tolerance.title: R² tolerance for model selection
selection_r2_tolerance.description: Maximum R² difference for treating candidate methods as similarly performing. Among these methods, selection prioritizes lower normalized RMSE, then lower relative bias, and finally higher R². Must be non-negative. Default: 0.05.

selection_max_bias_fraction.title: Maximum bias fraction for model selection
selection_max_bias_fraction.description: Maximum allowed absolute validation bias, expressed as a fraction of the absolute median of observed values. Must be non-negative. Default: 0.20.

selection_extreme_ratio_limit.title: Extreme value ratio limit for model selection
selection_extreme_ratio_limit.description: Ratio used to identify implausible extreme predictions when filling missing values, based on the observed reference range. Must be greater than zero. Default: 2.0.

interpolated_waterchem.title: Daily modelled water-chemistry NetCDF
interpolated_waterchem.description: Daily chemistry time series with observations preserved and missing values filled using the selected interpolation and fallback methods.
